P.name: We Are More
P.title: Template:Data Naafiri/We Are More
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|We Are More|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Naafiri
|skill        = I
|icon         = Naafiri We Are More.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Naafiri''' summons a ''Packmate'' that fights alongside her. She may have up to {{pp|2 to 5 for 4|1;9;12;15|formula=2 at level 1, then +1 at level 9, then +1 every 3 levels until 15}} ''Packmates'' at a time. '''Naafiri''' summons the maximum number of ''Packmates'' when the game starts and upon [[death|respawning]].
|description2 = Hitting {{tip|champions}} or large {{tip|monsters}} with {{tip|abilities}} reduces the {{sti|cooldown}} by 4 seconds. Killing enemies reduces it by 1 second.
|description3 = ''See [[Naafiri#Pets|Pets]] for full details on Packmates.''
|static       = {{pp|30 to 10|1;6;9;12;15}}
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|notes        = 
* ''Packmates'' do not count as abilities for triggering the cooldown reduction.
* Only the initial hit of ''{{ai|Darkin Daggers|Naafiri}}'' counts for reducing ''We Are More's'' cooldown; the damage over time will not trigger the cooldown reduction.
* Both hits of ''{{ai|Eviscerate|Naafiri}}'' will trigger the cooldown reduction.
|tips         = 
* Champions who have repeatable [[unit-targeted]] dashes available in their kit (e.g. {{cai|Bladesurge|Irelia}}, {{cai|Sweeping Blade|Yasuo}}) can utilize ''Packmates'' to effectively reach '''Naafiri'''.
<!--Blurb-->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Naafiri}} periodically summons a ''[[Naafiri#Pets|Packmate]]'' that attacks the target of her attacks and {{tip|abilities}}.
|blurb2       = Hitting {{tip|champions}} or large {{tip|monsters}} with abilities or killing enemies reduces the {{sti|cooldown}}.
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Naafiri_Original_P_2.ogg}} ''"We are more!"''
}}

W.name: The Call of the Pack
W.title: Template:Data Naafiri/The Call of the Pack
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|The Call of the Pack|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Naafiri
|skill        = W
|icon         = Naafiri The Call of the Pack.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Naafiri''' goes on the hunt for the next {{tt|5 seconds|Hunt begins from the start of the cast time}}, becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|ghosted}} for the first 1 second and {{tip|vanish|vanishing}} all of her active ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|Packmates}}'' in the first {{fd|0.9}} seconds. Her active ''Packmates'' will {{tip|blink|reappear}} near her after their vanish.
|description2 = After {{fd|1.25}} seconds into the hunt, '''Naafiri''' summons 2 additional ''Packmates'' that last for the remaining duration and can exceed ''{{ais|We Are More|Naafiri}}'' summon cap.
|description3 = While on the hunt, '''Naafiri''' gains {{as|20% AD}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and grants herself and all ''Packmates'' {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
|leveling3    = {{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 30}}%}}
|description4 = ''Casting {{ai|Hounds' Pursuit|Naafiri}} extends The Call of the Pack's hunt duration by {{fd|1.75}} seconds, up to its original duration.''
|description5 = '''''Naafiri''' can move during The Call of the Pack's cast time.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|26 to 18}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = 60
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self
|cast time    = {{fd|0.75}}
|notes        = 
* While ''The Call of the Pack'' is active, it increases ''{{ais|We Are More|Naafiri}}'' summon cap to {{pp|4 to 7 for 4|1;9;12;15|formula=4 at level 1, then +1 at level 9, then +1 every 3 levels until 15}}.
* The order of additional ''Packmates'' that despawn is predetermined, most likely their internal spawn IDs. The ability does not consider which ''Packmates'' are the closest or healthiest.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Naafiri}} goes on the hunt for a period, briefly becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|vanish|vanishing}} her ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|Packmates}}'', gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and granting herself and her ''Packmates'' {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' move speed}}}}. She will also summon extra ''Packmates'' that last for the hunt's duration.
|blurb2       = ''Casting {{ai|Hounds' Pursuit|Naafiri}} briefly extends The Call of the Pack's hunt duration.''
}}
